title: Dynamics 365 Sales: run multiple Sales Qualification Agents in one environment
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, admin controls and consumption-based licensing are supported. Minor corrections should explain the change from messages to Copilot Credits, qualify the regional consent prerequisite and complete the route from the dashboard to its lead views.
